product_metadata.title: Darice, White Mini Electric Iron (1pc), Ideal for Crafting, Sewing, Quilting and More – Compact and Portable – for Travel, College and Touch-Ups – 120-Volt, 15-Watt, 4” High
features: IDEAL FOR CRAFTING: This mini electric iron is a must have for a crafter. Works perfectly for small sewing projects, melting beads, doll clothes, small appliques, binding, patches and more.
EASY TO USE: Simply plug-in the 4” high iron and you’re ready to go. The 120-Volt, 15-watt electric iron only has a single temperature.
MORE THAN CRAFTS: Handy and extremely portable, the compact mini electric iron easily fits into totes, luggage and crafters’ toolboxes. Perfect for college, traveling and quick ironing touch-ups!
NOT A TOY: The mini crafting iron is not a toy and is intended for adult use only. Instructions included.

FIND YOUR INSPIRATION – Since 1954, Darice has been inspiring creativity with the best value and selection of art and craft supplies for every level crafter. From scrapbooking to jewelry making, kids’ crafts to fine art, floral design to your latest Pinterest project, Darice has over 45,000 items for every level of crafter.
description: Darice Mini Crafting Iron is a handy, portable size iron that will fit into your toolbox. It is great for college, travel or quick ironing touch-ups. Everyone needs a mini iron, they are ideal for all your crafting projects. Approximately 2 1/2 x 4 x 2 1/2 inch. Color chosen at random only.
